<section_guide number="3" title="Primary User Scenario">
<purpose>Turn the confirmed Primary Persona's core ideal use cases into intent-led demo scenarios.</purpose>

<questions>
1. Which core ideal use cases best reveal the product's intent for the confirmed Primary Persona?
2. For each use case, what intent, starting context, user actions, and completion result must the PoC show?
</questions>

<workflow>
Use the same Primary Persona approved in Section 1. Multiple core ideal use cases are allowed.
For each use case:

1. Start with an explicit "Intent" statement naming the product intent this use case demonstrates.
2. State the concrete starting context.
3. Draft three to eight sequential steps led by the persona's actions. For every step, state the
   user action first, then the visible product response and expected result.
4. End with an observable completion result.

Use one recognizable actor, a specific starting situation, consecutive actions, and a visible
result. Do not write a capability list or a sequence made only of product responses. Add at most two
interruptions only when they materially affect what the PoC must demonstrate. Do not expand
secondary personas, alternative journeys, or every error here.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm every core ideal use case's intent, sequential user actions, and observable completion result before saving.</completion>
</section_guide>
